symptom: with decoding and file reads cached (ako/mxcli#2160), the check before an exec was still a quarter of a 600-page script: per page statement it listed the domain models four times, the microflows three times and the nanoflows twice, and loaded each pluggable widget's template again
cause: each validator builds its own index from a backend listing - buildEntityIndex, buildEntityQualifiedNames, checkMemberTypeIndex and checkAssociationCatalog from ListDomainModels, buildFlowSignatures (reached from two validators) from ListMicroflows and ListNanoflows - and each is called per statement. templatePropertyTypes says 'once per widget for the run' but its cache is created inside the call, and the call is per statement. Below them every listing copied each unit's bytes out of the content cache (bytes.Clone) for a decoder that only reads them, and the decode cache then compared those bytes with its own (memeqbody): 12 s and 9 s of an 84 s stage, plus the collector's work to clear the copies
insight: A check reads the project and never writes it, so one pass may list each kind once; the memo hangs on the pass's ExecContext and is nil during execution, where a statement must see what the one before it wrote. That makes the change a mechanical substitution of ctx.Backend.ListX() in the validate*.go files, with no behaviour change outside a check - but a text substitution also rewrote s.ctx.Backend.ListX(), so compile and read the diff. A cache declared inside a function that is called per statement is not a cache 'for the run': look at where the closure is made, not at its comment. For the copies: count them (Reader.UnitContentCopies) rather than time them, and once the decoder is handed the cache's own slice an unchanged unit is recognised by slice identity before any byte is compared. Measured: listings per added page statement 4/3/2 -> 0; the 300/600/600 seed's page stage 84 s -> 64 s from the shared bytes alone. Still per statement after this: ListPages (one, from outside validate*.go), GetProjectSettings, the exec-side template load (augmentFromMPK per widget instance) and the gen -> sdk conversion of each listing at exec time.
